store_presence.short_description: Official Microsoft Edge integration for MJDM native download accelerator.
store_presence.description:
Seamlessly forward downloads from Microsoft Edge to your local MJDM desktop application for up to 32-stream multi-segment acceleration.

Features:
- Automatic link interception
- Media sniffer for web video and audio
- Page link batch extractor
- Instant fail-open fallback
- 100% private and zero external telemetry
